verdicts.reason: A and B look the same to the eye. I couldn't run a pixel diff because the command needed approval. Both keep the original left-to-right banner order (product circle, headline, NEW pill, dark 'Try It' button) and the brand colours, so the design is clearly the same. In both, the subline 'New botanical sparkling, out now.' is too small to read at 320x50. The NEW pill and the 'Try It' label are also very small. The product circle sits cramped against the left and top edges, and the headline is the only element that reads at this size.
